column1: # Environment variables the product names at a user and the documentation does
# not explain, with the reason each one is allowed to stay that way.
# Two tab separated fields: the variable, and why it is not documented. A reason
# is required, because an exemption with no argument behind it cannot be told
# apart from somebody silencing a finding they did not understand. An exemption
# that stops being needed is reported, so this list cannot rot: figurecheck's
# equivalent had five stale rows found in one evening, which is only possible
# The reason has to be true, and that is the whole mechanism. A variable only
# ever named inside a message aimed at somebody working on this repository can
# say so. A variable a customer is told to set cannot be given a truthful reason
# here, and the answer is then to document it. The two that this gate was
# written for, AF_LICENSE_KEY and AF_ORG, would have needed a row, and there was
# nothing true to write in one: `af license install` tells a paying customer to
# THIS FILE IS EMPTY, and that is a result rather than an oversight. Every
# variable the engine or the enterprise binary names at a user is documented as
# of 2026-09-01. It exists for the next one.
